title: Spicy Syrian Salmon Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic pilaf dish from Syria, featuring spicy salmon as the main ingredient.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the salmon and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the salmon from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of olive oil to the skillet and cook the chopped red onion until translucent.
Stir in the spicy Syrian pilaf seasoning and cook for 1 minute.
Add the yellow rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and spice mixture.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the rice is lightly toasted.
Fluff the rice with a fork to separate the grains.
Serve the spicy salmon on top of the pilaf, garnished with chopped parsley.
